mapper.select: SELECT te.ENTRY_ID as entryId, te.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, te.ENTRY_NO as entryNo, te.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, te.DEBIT_AMOUNT as debitAmount, te.CREDIT_AMOUNT as creditAmount, te.CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, te.EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, te.AUXILIARY_INFO as auxiliaryInfo, te.BOOK_ID as bookId, te.TENANT_ID as tenantId, te.VERSION as version, te.CREATE_TIME as createTime, te.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, te.CREATOR as creator, te.UPDATER as updater, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY te LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s ON te.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE te.IS_DELETED = 0 AND te.TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId} ORDER BY te.ENTRY_NO ASC

SELECT te.ENTRY_ID as entryId, te.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, te.ENTRY_NO as entryNo, te.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, te.DEBIT_AMOUNT as debitAmount, te.CREDIT_AMOUNT as creditAmount, te.CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, te.EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, te.AUXILIARY_INFO as auxiliaryInfo, te.BOOK_ID as bookId, te.TENANT_ID as tenantId, te.VERSION as version, te.CREATE_TIME as createTime, te.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, te.CREATOR as creator, te.UPDATER as updater, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY te LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s ON te.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE te.IS_DELETED = 0 AND te.SUBJECT_ID = #{subjectId} AND te.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND te.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY te.ENTRY_NO ASC

SELECT te.ENTRY_ID as entryId, te.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, te.ENTRY_NO as entryNo, te.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, te.DEBIT_AMOUNT as debitAmount, te.CREDIT_AMOUNT as creditAmount, te.CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, te.EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, te.AUXILIARY_INFO as auxiliaryInfo, te.BOOK_ID as bookId, te.TENANT_ID as tenantId, te.VERSION as version, te.CREATE_TIME as createTime, te.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, te.CREATOR as creator, te.UPDATER as updater, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY te LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s ON te.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE te.IS_DELETED = 0 AND te.CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode} AND te.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND te.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY te.ENTRY_NO ASC
SELECT #{transactionId} as transactionId, SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) as debitAmount, SUM(CREDIT_AMOUNT) as creditAmount FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
SELECT CASE WHEN ABS(SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) - SUM(CREDIT_AMOUNT)) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}

SELECT te.SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, s.SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, s.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, COUNT(*) as entryId FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY te LEFT JOIN T_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT s ON te.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE te.IS_DELETED = 0 AND te.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND te.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY te.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE ASC

SELECT CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, COUNT(*) as entryId, SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) as debitAmount, SUM(CREDIT_AMOUNT) as creditAmount FROM T_TRANSACTION_ENTRY WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY CURRENCY_CODE ORDER BY CURRENCY_CODE ASC
